title: Entergy volunteers help move Capitol Green Connector project forward
summary: Volunteers—including Entergy employees—helped plant trees and landscaping along the Capitol Green Connector, making downtown Jackson greener and more welcoming. Supported by local organizations, the project extends the Museum Trail and connects key destinations. Source

title: FIA white paper guides Agreement States on fusion regulation
summary: The Fusion Industry Association has released a white paper providing guidance to current and future Agreement States on how to prepare for potential commercial fusion energy companies that may be looking to set up facilities.

title: Full text, enrichment details emerge on Saudi 123 Agreement
summary: On July 22, the Department of Energy announced that Energy Secretary Chris Wright and Saudi Minister of Energy Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman had signed a 123 Agreement to facilitate peaceful nuclear cooperation between the two countries. The agreement now awaits congressional approval. At the time of the signing, Wright said, “Rest assured, these agreements uphold the highest standards of nuclear safety and nonproliferation while relying on the world's best nuclear technology and scientists, designed right here in the United States.”

title: DOE loan, task force report spur nuclear momentum in Iowa
summary: NextEra Energy has secured a Department of Energy loan of up to $1.9 billion for its restart of the Duane Arnold nuclear power plant in Linn County, Iowa. The announcement that NextEra and the DOE’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing had closed on a loan came this morning, less than a week after the state’s Nuclear Energy Task Force issued a final report on the feasibility of new nuclear projects in Iowa.
